messages:
emma: Deploy finished in eu1: rollout of model v2-quant -> 100% at 2259001234
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout complete for v2-quant in eu1 (10 hosts). Canary->region roll. CI smoke checks passed.
sohail: seeing a jump in synth-embed p95 for eu1 after the rollout, trending from ~45ms -> ~220ms on our synthetic probe. Not seen in us-east yet.
maria: confirmed on dashboards, heatmap shows tail latency spike pinned to hosts eu1-a,b,c. Digging traces now.
sohail: copying probe log snippet:
```
[SYNTH-PROBE] probe_id=embed-eu1-202503  p50=30ms p95=220ms p99=480ms  errors=0  trace=tr_0a1b2c
[TRACE] gpu_wait_ms=200 nvlink_retry=3 kernel_queue_delay=180
```
jin: ouch. Could be a kernel/kernelsel mismatch with the quantized kernels on that HW batch size. Can we pin region to previous model variant while we triage?
emma: agree. We should do a per-region pin rather than full rollback so product impact is minimal.
sohail: I'm going to apply a route pin for eu1 to v1-stable and re-run synth probes. Command I'm going to run:
```shell
/deploy-bot pin-route --region=eu1 --route-to=model:v1-stable --reason="postdeploy synth p95 spike"
```
sohail: running now.
deploy-bot: ACK: pin-route accepted. Route eu1 -> model:v1-stable (applied to 10 hosts). user=sohail action=pin-route id=pin-202503-778
ops-bot: incident created INC-2025-342: "eu1 synth p95 spike after v2-quant rollout" assigned to eng-releases oncall.
maria: re-ran synth probes 30s after pin. p95 back to ~48ms, p99 ~90ms. Looks like the pin mitigated the tail.
sohail: monitoring for 10m. If stable, we'll leave the partial pin and mark the release notes: partial regional pin applied to eu1 pending investigation. I'll open a follow-up ticket to reproduce with smaller batch / perf flags.
emma: please add a short note to the release change window doc and the PR: "partial pin applied to eu1 due to post-deploy synthetic p95 regression, investigation ongoing."
jin: for the investigation: recommend collecting kernel selection logs + nvlink telemetry from the pinned hosts and try a warmstart with different batch padding. I'll take it.
sohail: thanks. If anything spikes again I'll escalate and we can roll back entirely. For now leave the pin. :thumbsup:
emma: ACK. Thanks team.
